newsitem.title: ITALY: Falling Italian consumption seen hurting upswing.
newsitem.headline: Falling Italian consumption seen hurting upswing.

text.p: Falling consumption in Italy could put a brake on a gentle upswing in industrial output, a study by the Italian industrial employers' association Confindustria said.

"The revival of productive activity is still very gradual and it's being pulled along by the non-consumer durables industry," said the study published on Thursday by Confindustria's research department.

But the increase could merely result in stocks piling up because consumer confidence among households has taken a turn for the worse and "any fall in consumption could halt the already modest revival."
The study said the gap between minimum contractual pay levels and real take home pay was widening and this was posing a risk on the inflation front.
The pace at which inflation was falling was expected to slow down in the first half of 1997. -- Milan newsroom +392-66102321
